dedupe_keys.name: willow operational ai and digital twin platform for buildings

description: Willow describes its product as an operational AI platform for buildings and portfolios, in which a digital twin unifies spatial, static and live data from building systems. Its features include Willow Copilot for conversational AI in operations, fault prediction and autonomous response, cross-system diagnostics scored by cost, energy and comfort impact, and a knowledge graph that Willow calls the most complete buildings ontology; data connectors and AI skills are sold as Activate Packs. The site lists solutions for education campuses, airports and hospitals, and names clients in retail, pharmaceuticals and real estate. Coverage: generic; the facilities a client connects. Access: by demo request; no prices are published. Licence: commercial. Caveats: the site blocked direct automated reading, so it was read through a web-fetch summary on 2026-09-26; deployment details were not stated and the claims are the vendor's own. Simulation uses: live operational twins of airports, hospitals and campuses that supply fault, energy and comfort data for critical facility studies. Related records: Siemens Building X, Azure Digital Twins and the RealEstateCore ontology.
